g.text: Where the money goes: Cloudflare (measured) beside AWS Lambda (estimated)
container egress: every byte a container sends,
to the Worker too (measured) - $0.025/GB after 1 TB/month
free: R2 has no egress fee
1:44:00 project, 1080p, Standard tier: Cloudflare $2.23 measured ($2.67 with egress above the allowance and idle warm time)
against $2.17 - $3.20 estimated on AWS. Red: billed. Green: free.
